0.heading: HGS India shares debut at 34% premium on NSE Emerge
0.intro: HGS India shares made a positive debut on the stock market on November 6, listing at a premium of around 34 percent over the initial public offering (IPO) price on the NSE Emerge platform.
0.body:
HGS India shares made a positive debut on the stock market on November 6, listing at a premium of around 34 percent over the initial public offering (IPO) price on the NSE Emerge platform.

The shares listed at Rs 160 apiece, compared with the IPO issue price of Rs 120, translating into a listing gain of 33.33 percent.

The listing was broadly in line with grey market expectations. HGS India was commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of around Rs 40 per share ahead of its debut, indicating a potential listing price of Rs 160, according to InvestorGain.

Read Also: Maxwell Engineering Solutions shares list at 90% premium on NSE Emerge

However, the grey market is unofficial and unregulated. GMP is only an indicator of investor sentiment and does not guarantee the actual listing price or listing gains.

HGS India's Rs 34.56-crore IPO received a strong response from investors, with the issue subscribed 231.18 times by the close of the three-day bidding period on November 3.

Investors placed bids for approximately 47.77 crore equity shares against the net offer of around 20.66 lakh shares during the subscription period between October 30 and November 3.

The IPO comprised a fresh issue of 23.26 lakh equity shares worth Rs 27.91 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 5.54 lakh shares worth Rs 6.65 crore by existing shareholders, including promoters.

The company had fixed the price band at Rs 114-120 per share. The IPO allotment was finalised on November 4, while refunds and credit of shares to demat accounts were scheduled for November 5.

HGS India plans to utilise Rs 15.05 crore from the net proceeds of the fresh issue towards replacing plant and machinery at its existing manufacturing facility in Manesar, Gurugram.

Another Rs 1.05 crore will be allocated towards setting up an in-house gold plating facility as part of its backward integration plans.

Check IPO News Here

The company has also earmarked Rs 3.26 crore for infrastructure development on the third floor of its existing manufacturing facility. The remaining proceeds will be utilised for pursuing unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes.

About HGS India

HGS India manufactures geophones, geophone strings, seismic cables, geophysical connectors and accessories used in seismic data collection.

Established in 1986, the company operates a manufacturing facility in Manesar, Haryana, and has around four decades of manufacturing experience.

Its products are used across several industries, including oil and gas exploration, defence research, mineral exploration, vibration monitoring, geophysical seabed surveys and earthquake seismology. The company also caters to academic and applied research institutions.

1.headline: Maxwell Engineering Solutions shares list at 90% premium on NSE Emerge
1.heading: Maxwell Engineering Solutions shares list at 90% premium on NSE Emerge
1.intro: Maxwell Engineering Solutions shares made a blockbuster debut on the stock market on November 6, listing at a premium of 90 percent over the IPO price on the NSE Emerge platform.
1.body:
Maxwell Engineering Solutions shares made a blockbuster debut on the stock market on November 6, listing at a premium of 90 percent over the IPO price on the NSE Emerge platform.

The shares listed at Rs 300.20 apiece, compared with the IPO issue price of Rs 158, delivering a listing gain of Rs 142.20 per share to investors who received an allotment.

The debut also exceeded grey market expectations. Maxwell Engineering Solutions was commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of around 67% on the morning of November 6, according to Investorgain.

However, the grey market is an unofficial market, and GMP trends are not a reliable indicator of the actual listing price. The final listing performance depends on prevailing market conditions and investor sentiment.

The company's Rs 57.64-crore initial public offering (IPO) received an overwhelming response from investors, with the issue subscribed 491.39 times by the close of the three-day bidding period on November 3.

The IPO witnessed strong demand across all investor categories, with non-institutional investors (NIIs) leading the subscription tally. The NII portion was subscribed around 858 times, while the retail investor category saw subscription of approximately 556 times. The qualified institutional buyer (QIB) portion was subscribed 259.4 times.

Investors placed bids for approximately 128.94 crore equity shares against the 26.24 lakh shares on offer during the subscription period between October 30 and November 3. The total value of bids stood at approximately Rs 20,372 crore.

Maxwell Engineering Solutions launched its Rs 57.64-crore IPO through a fresh issue of 36.48 lakh equity shares. The company had fixed the price band at Rs 150-158 per share.

Check IPO News Here

The Gujarat-based company manufactures precision-engineered components used in underwater pelletising systems.

The company plans to utilise Rs 18 crore from the net IPO proceeds towards purchasing new machinery, laboratory equipment and other utilities for its manufacturing facility.

Another Rs 6.5 crore has been earmarked for the construction of a new office building and manufacturing facility. Further, Rs 4.3 crore will be used to repay outstanding borrowings, while Rs 14 crore has been allocated for working capital requirements. The remaining proceeds will be utilised for general corporate purposes.

JDA Capital Services was the book-running lead manager to the issue, while KFin Technologies acted as the registrar.

2.headline: Antala Industries IPO subscribed 12.2 times on final day, listing likely next week
2.heading: Antala Industries IPO subscribed 12.2 times on final day, listing likely next week
2.intro: Antala Industries is raising Rs 22.98 crore via maiden public issue of 34.82 lakh equity shares at the upper end of price band of Rs 62-66 per share.
2.body:
Rajkot-based packaging solutions provider Antala Industries' initial public offering (IPO) received a strong response from investors, closing with 12.2 times subscription on November 5.

The company is expected to finalise the IPO share allotment by November 6, while trading in Antala shares on the BSE SME platform is scheduled to begin on November 11.

Investors placed bids for 4.24 crore equity shares over six days from October 29, against an offer size of 34.82 lakh shares, through 5,293 applications.

Qualified institutional buyers led the subscription, bidding 66.72 times their allotted quota. The portions reserved for non-institutional and retail investors were subscribed 37.38 times and 5.22 times, respectively.

Antala Industries is raising Rs 22.98 crore through its maiden public issue of 34.82 lakh equity shares at the upper end of the price band of Rs 62-66 per share.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

With manufacturing facilities in Rajkot, the company makes industrial and commercial packaging products, specialising in BOPP bags, BOPP printing rolls, BOPP lamination rolls, PP woven bags and PP woven fabric rolls. It provides packaging solutions to customers in sectors such as food processing, fertilisers, chemicals, cement and seeds.

The company intends to utilise Rs 10.68 crore of the net IPO proceeds for working capital requirements and Rs 5.89 crore for capital expenditure towards the purchase of machinery. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Vatsa Capital Venture is acting as the merchant banker for the Antala Industries IPO.
